text:
Rina Torres: Pushing an idea for the allocator/compaction follow-up: make the defragger honor a strict epoch budget and use an indirection header plus retire-list to avoid late-write stomps. Short notes below.
Alex Park: Sounds promising. Why epoch budget vs continuous background?
Rina Torres: Epoch budget bounds tail risk. We run compact epochs every X ms and cap time/pages so background work cant cause unpredictable latency spikes.
Jules M.: How do you stop compacting hot pages? We had issues with thrashing.
Rina Torres: Two levers: sampled hotness EMA (1% sampled accesses) + allocation hints. Runner skips pages with hotness>threshold and respects per-tenant defrag_aggressiveness.
Priya Rao: Explain the indirection header model. Any perf hit on reads?
Rina Torres: Header = two words: (ptr, seq). Reader does atomic read of both before/after access; if seq changed or odd (migrating), retry. Simple and lockfree. Very small CPU hit on unlucky retries; common-case is one atomic load.
Alex Park: DMA completions stomping new allocations was nasty. How does retire-list help?
Rina Torres: On migrate, mark old page RETIRING + retire_epoch = current_epoch + retire_hold. Runner only returns retired pages after retire_epoch. Default retire_hold=1 epoch which covers DMA windows.
Jules M.: What if memory pressure requires early reuse?
Rina Torres: Forced reclaim path: allocator can request immediate reclaim; page goes through zeroing/fence and we increment reclaimed_under_pressure_count. Also we expose max_retired_ratio to avoid unbounded resident growth.
Priya Rao: Migration cost model?
Rina Torres: Cost_move = bytes/est_bandwidth + pcie_latency + cpu_copy_cost. Benefit = sample_fault_count * avg_fault_cost. Move if benefit*profit_factor > cost_move. Keep linear and calibrate with telemetry.
Alex Park: Rollout plan?
Rina Torres: 1) Unit tests + model sim. 2) Lab canary with tiny budget (epoch_ms=50, pages_limit=128, retire_hold=1). 3) Prod canary with telemetry on retired_ratio, move_cost_hist, stale_write_detects, p95 token latency.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for branch "epochal-defrag" on lab-node-7 :eyes:
Jules M.: Metrics to add: retire_hold_hist, forced_reclaims, header_retry_rate. Also alert if retired_ratio>0.2.
Rina Torres: Thanks. I'll open a short RFC addendum with diagrams and a perf harness stub. Volunteers to review tests?
Priya Rao: I'll take the sampling and metrics hooks.
Alex Park: I'll sanity-check the cost model and telemetry labels.
Rina Torres: Great. Goal: safe compaction without global pauses and no late DMA stomps. Short prototype by EOD next week. :thumbsup:
